rules.description: The United States are (is) 246 years old
rules.message: In American English, 'the United States' is considered a singular entity, and therefore takes a third-person verb form.
examples: The United States are not currently the only cultural imperialists, but today, as a global economic and political superpower, the spread of American values in the entire world is at the leading edge of a wave of spread of Western goods and consumerist culture.
A noted series of HPIs for the United States are the Case–Shiller indices, devised by American economists Karl Case, Robert J. Shiller, and Allan Weiss.
In another twenty years, the United States will no longer be able to be the police for the world.
In that final, the United States upset the Cubans, beating them 4–0.

Fur company posts that became cities in what is now the United States include Vancouver, Washington (Fort Vancouver), formerly the "capital" of Hudson's Bay operations in the Columbia District, Colville, Washington and Walla Walla, Washington (old Fort Nez Percés).
The United States <marker>are</marker> 246 years old.
is
If the United States <marker>try</marker> to hit and annihilate Iran, this will be its last war.
tries
Whenever the United States <marker>do</marker> not succeed in invading, annihilating, dividing or controlling a country, they feel humiliated.

    <token chunk="B-NP-plural"><exception postag="CD"/></token>
  </antipattern>
  <antipattern>
    <token chunk="E-NP-plural"/>
    <token regexp="yes">of|for</token>
    <token>the</token>
    <token>united</token>
    <token>states</token>
  </antipattern>
  <antipattern>
    <token regexp="yes">.+s</token>
    <token regexp="yes">of|for</token>
    <token>the</token>
    <token>united</token>
    <token>states</token>
  </antipattern>
  <antipattern>
    <token chunk="B-PP" skip="5"/>
    <token>the</token>
    <token>united</token>
    <token>states</token>
  </antipattern>
  <pattern>
    <token postag="SENT_START|CC|PCT" postag_regexp="yes"><exception>and</exception></token>
    <token>the</token>
    <token>united</token>
    <token>states</token><marker>

rules.message: Unless punctuating an abbreviation or acronym, periods should not appear both inside and outside of a quote.

Adchem Corp. ".
"An Introduction to the Syntax and Content of Cyc.".
The Church of Denmark still uses the phrase "We renounce the devil and all his doings and all his beings" as the beginning of this creed, before the line "We believe in God etc.".

  <antipattern>
    <token case_sensitive="yes" regexp="yes">[A-Z]</token>
    <token>.</token>
    <token regexp="yes">["”]</token>
    <token postag="SENT_END">.</token>
  <example>Oh, and the term "jewfro" definitely predates "The O.C.".</example>
  </antipattern>
  <antipattern>
    <token regexp="yes">co(rp)?|cyc|etc|inc|ste</token>
    <token>.</token>
    <token regexp="yes">["”]</token>
    <token postag="SENT_END">.</token>
  <example>Adchem Corp. ". </example>
  <example>"An Introduction to the Syntax and Content of Cyc.".</example>
  <example>The Church of Denmark still uses the phrase "We renounce the devil and all his doings and all his beings" as the beginning of this creed, before the line "We believe in God etc.". </example>
  </antipattern>
  <pattern>
    <token><exception>.</exception></token>
    <token>.</token>
    <token regexp="yes">["”]</token>
    <token postag="SENT_END">.</token>
  </pattern>
  <message>Unless punctuating an abbreviation or acronym, periods should not appear both inside and outside of a quote.</message>
  <suggestion>\1\2\3</suggestion>
  <short>Potential error</short>
  <example correction="checker.”">It turned out that Google was promoting this app every time someone searched for a “spell <marker>checker.”.</marker></example>

  <filter args="year:\6 month:\2 day:\4" class="org.languagetool.rules.en.FutureDateFilter"/>
